method: Scheduled Pillar Two 30-day news refresh (12 Nov 2026 HKT): WebSearch plus fetching primary official pages for OECD, HK IRD, SG IRAS/MOF/SSO, and JP NTA. Items added only when date and content were confirmed against a fetched source.

coverage.OECD: Checked 12 Nov 2026: OECD GloBE Model Rules page, 18th plenary announcement (30 Oct) and Tax Certainty Day materials re-fetched. No new model rules, AG, GIR, Central Record or Full Legislative Review since catalogued items (plenary 30 Oct; GIR XML Schema v2.0 20 Oct; Romania STTR 2 Oct). Latest AG on the official page remains September 2026. 4 Nov Tax Certainty Day OECD release is 2025 MAP/APA statistics (BEPS Action 14), not a standalone GloBE document; Corwin remarks on a taxpayer-initiated coordination mechanism remain process comments only. No standalone OECD GloBE document published since the 30 Oct plenary statement. ATO 9 Nov GIR/XML link update remains Australia-only (out of scope).
coverage.HK: Checked 12 Nov 2026: IRD What's New and GMT/HKMTT page fetched. Only in-window Pillar Two item remains 26 Oct Portal BIR82 filing / e-assessments. 2–4 Nov What's New / press covers LegCo CARF & Amended CRS Bill — not Pillar Two. No new HKMTT/IIR guidance or portal change since 11 Nov.
coverage.SG: Checked 12 Nov 2026: IRAS GloBE/DTT page, IRAS Latest Updates (through 3 Nov GST/acknowledgement items; latest Pillar Two e-Tax Guide still 30 Oct), PwC Singapore Tax News (latest SG Pillar Two entries remain 4 Nov Act 23 and 30 Oct Third Edition guide) and SSO SL-Supp November 2026 browse re-fetched. Catalogued items unchanged: Finance (Income Taxes) Act 2026 (Act 23) published Acts Supplement 4 Nov; Third Edition e-Tax Guide (30 Oct; still the latest IRAS Pillar Two e-Tax Guide on Latest Updates); QTI/SBTI list (13 Oct). No new MMT Regulations for safe harbours; no new IRAS guidance or SSO MMT subsidiary legislation since 11 Nov.
coverage.JP: Checked 12 Nov 2026: NTA 新着情報 fetched (through 11 Nov driver-recruitment post; no Pillar Two items after 21 Oct). In-window catalogued item unchanged (GIR AEOI partners 21 Oct). 11 Nov driver recruitment; 9 Nov student tax-essay awards; 2 Nov tobacco hand-held stock tax; 30 Oct CbCR EOI partner-list update and 法人税基本通達 opinion solicitation confirmed non-Pillar Two (CbCR ≠ GIR). The 9 Oct 趣旨説明 remains catalogued but falls before the rolling 30-day window starting ~13 Oct. No new JP IIR/QDMTT/GIR administrative guidance.
